title: Dashboard module endpoints and staged frontend loading
goal: Split the dashboard overview aggregation into smaller read endpoints so the first screen can load summary metrics before heavier chart, rules, high-risk, LLM quality, and health modules.
changes: Added dashboard module endpoints for summary, review trend, risk distribution, rules, high-risk reviews, and LLM quality while keeping /api/v1/dashboard/overview compatible.
Separated dashboard module caches and extended dashboard cache eviction to clear overview and module caches together.
Changed the frontend overview page to request summary first, then load dashboard modules in parallel; LLM trend-window changes now refresh only the LLM quality module.
Added controller, service, and cache tests for the new dashboard module contracts and cache boundaries.

commands.summary: whitespace, repository governance, Flyway, demo-data guard, and secret scan passed

nextStep: Continue OPT-ARCH-028 with GitHub comment preview pagination and lazy loading, then revisit remaining dashboard snapshot or observability work.
